svg.title: Move Bitwig controller — control reference
svg.desc: Move top panel with its display, wheel, eight parameter knobs, Volume, four track keys, 32 pads, 16 steps, Back, Menu, transport, modifiers and navigation. Button symbols match the physical controller. Six reference cards cover starting a song, notes and drums, Session, devices, modifiers, volume and Mixer.

g.text: 32 pads · notes, drums, clips and scenes
Steps 1–16 · sequence notes in Note · select / stop tracks in Session
New instrument + browser / new audio track
Choose a sound / load it / cancel
Play a pad, then tap steps
Build a phrase; first step creates a missing clip
Select track; sequencer follows its clip
Play notes; tap steps to add / remove a note
Note modifiers: velocity, chance, repeat, more
Hold modifier + wheel, then press step
Set a modifier and apply it to that step
Phrase pages · octave or drum bank
Launch clips / scenes; Shift + scene stops it
Select a clip for editing without launching
Select track / stop that track’s clips
Add a device after the selected device
Start or stop / overdub in Note, record elsewhere
Mute + track / drum · Shift + Mute tap
Mute a track / drum · solo selected track
Delete / duplicate tracks; delete / copy clips
Change clip length; Shift makes fine edits
Hold track key / drum pad + Volume
Adjust that track / drum chain’s volume
Track levels / Main; hold Mute for pan
Workflow settings / Key & Scale in Note
